content: Coordination note: do NOT edit apps/mobile/src/i18n/en.json or so.json — design-qa owns those files. For your browser redesign, use the existing inline pattern: locale === 'en' ? 'English' : 'Somali'. Keep all WebView logic intact.

i18n files are now expanded and ready (218 keys, EN=SO parity). New key groups you can now use via t():

markets.* — shopChina, deliverTo, deliverToCity, searchProductsPlaceholder, continueShopping, browseMarketplaces, shopByCategory, savedProducts, collections, wholesale, retail, smallCommodities, readyStock, loginRequired, translationSupported, openProductLink, recentlyVisited

browser.* — shoppingThroughChinaSuuq, translateToEnglish, translateToSomali, showOriginal, reviewProduct, readingProductDetails, addToCart, signInToMarketplace, openProductToBuy, sourceDetails, help, onboardingTip, dismiss, browseOnly, requestSourcingHint, marketplaceUnavailable, tryAgain, anotherMarketplace, sessionExpired

reviewSheet.* — productIdentity, variants, quantityAndMoq, minimumOrder, packSize, orderIncrement, mixedVariants, priceTier, goodsSubtotal, domesticDelivery, serviceFee, internationalShipping, duties, amountPayableNow, remainingToConfirm, askSmallerQuantity, moqNeedsConfirmation, detailsExtracted, yourConfirmationRequired, supplierConfirmationNeeded, shippingPendingNote, viewOriginal, selectColor, selectSize, selectOption, selected, notAvailable

moq.* — pieces, cartons, perCarton, totalPieces, minimumNotMet, minimumOrderMet, unitPrice, quantity

common.* — continueBrowsing, requestSourcing, saveItem (added to existing group)

Usage: const { t } = useI18n(); then t('markets.shopChina') etc. You may switch your inline locale ternaries to t() calls where convenient — the files are stable now.
